name: EPIC-SOUNDS: Audio-Oriented Actions in Egocentric Video
description: EPIC-SOUNDS is a large-scale audio-oriented dataset for egocentric video understanding from the University of Bristol. Built on top of the 100 hours of unscripted egocentric video from EPIC-KITCHENS-100, EPIC-SOUNDS provides 115,704 temporal audio event annotations across 44 audio classes. Annotations capture acoustic interactions (chopping, sizzling, running water, pouring, scraping) with precise start and end timestamps and audio-action labels, establishing a rigorous benchmark for egocentric audio-visual and audio-only action recognition.
